name: Svenska helgdagar och helgdagsaftnar — alla kategorier (1990–2030)
title: Svenska helgdagar och helgdagsaftnar — alla kategorier (1990–2030)
description: Comprehensive Swedish holiday catalog from 1990 through 2030, covering ALL four categories exposed by vacanza/holidays for Sweden: PUBLIC (allmänna helgdagar — statutory holidays per Lag (1989:253) including Nyårsdagen, Trettondedag jul, Långfredagen, Påskdagen, Annandag påsk, Första maj, Kristi himmelsfärdsdag, Pingstdagen, Sveriges nationaldag, Midsommardagen, Alla helgons dag, Juldagen, Annandag jul — and ALL Sundays which are legally equivalent to general holidays); OPTIONAL (helgdagsaftnar — Påskafton, Pingstafton, Trettondagsafton från 14:00, Skärtorsdagen från 14:00, Valborgsmässoafton från 14:00, Klämdag — widely observed but not statutory); BANK (half-days from 14:00 the day before major holidays plus Julafton — banking-sector custom); DE_FACTO (Julafton, Midsommarafton, Nyårsafton — universally observed as non-working in Sweden despite not being statutory). Generated from the vacanza/holidays Python library (MIT) algorithmic implementation in holidays/countries/sweden.py. Multilingual names in Swedish (sv, default/native), English (en_US), Thai (th) and Ukrainian (uk) per Sweden.supported_languages = ('en_US', 'sv', 'th', 'uk'). Easter-derived dates use Western Christian computation. Native Swedish characters (å, ä, ö) preserved via ensure_ascii=False.

meta.description: Comprehensive Swedish holiday catalog from 1990 through 2030, covering ALL four categories exposed by vacanza/holidays for Sweden: PUBLIC (allmänna helgdagar — statutory holidays per Lag (1989:253) including Nyårsdagen, Trettondedag jul, Långfredagen, Påskdagen, Annandag påsk, Första maj, Kristi himmelsfärdsdag, Pingstdagen, Sveriges nationaldag, Midsommardagen, Alla helgons dag, Juldagen, Annandag jul — and ALL Sundays which are legally equivalent to general holidays); OPTIONAL (helgdagsaftnar — Påskafton, Pingstafton, Trettondagsafton från 14:00, Skärtorsdagen från 14:00, Valborgsmässoafton från 14:00, Klämdag — widely observed but not statutory); BANK (half-days from 14:00 the day before major holidays plus Julafton — banking-sector custom); DE_FACTO (Julafton, Midsommarafton, Nyårsafton — universally observed as non-working in Sweden despite not being statutory). Generated from the vacanza/holidays Python library (MIT) algorithmic implementation in holidays/countries/sweden.py. Multilingual names in Swedish (sv, default/native), English (en_US), Thai (th) and Ukrainian (uk) per Sweden.supported_languages = ('en_US', 'sv', 'th', 'uk'). Easter-derived dates use Western Christian computation. Native Swedish characters (å, ä, ö) preserved via ensure_ascii=False. Innehåller 3460 poster. Ladda ner i Excel, CSV, PDF format.
